common.brandFull: Egyptian Italian Company for Textiles & Garments

home.heroLead: A vertical knitwear house in Cairo, making polos, T-shirts and jerseywear for European and American brands — from dyed yarn to the sealed export carton.
home.heroCaption: Fig. 01 — Cotton yarn, before it becomes anything.
home.manifestoQuote: We are proud to say, not in a shy way, that we do it our way.
home.manifestoBody: Egytaltex was born in 2001 on Egyptian land, but with an Italian mentality. Year after year, with a lot of hard work, it grew into a small vertical company built on one idea: if we control every step, we can stand behind every piece.
home.journeyTitle: One thread, followed all the way.
home.journeyLead: Four sister companies, one chain. Nothing leaves our hands until it is ready to leave Egypt.

journey.title: Yarn dyeing
journey.body: The best cotton yarn in the world, dyed to the colour of the season.

journey.title: Circular knitting
journey.body: Jersey, piqué and interlock, knitted every day on our own circular machines.

journey.title: Fabric dyeing & finishing
journey.body: Colour, hand-feel and stability are set before a single cut is made.

journey.title: Flat-knit collars
journey.body: Collars and cuffs knitted to match, so a polo reads as one piece.

journey.title: Cut & sew
journey.body: Patterns cut and garments sewn on our own floor in the Free Zone.

journey.title: Embroidery & print
journey.body: Logos embroidered in-house; prints by our sister studio.

journey.title: Enzyme wash & softening
journey.body: Garment-washed for the lived-in softness Italian brands ask for.

journey.title: Packed for export
journey.body: Inspected, folded and shipped to Italy, the USA, England and South Africa.

home.rangeTitle: Knitwear, made for people who notice.
home.rangeLead: 100% cotton, made to order, in the quantities a real collection needs.
home.marketsTitle: Made in Cairo. Worn across four markets.
home.clientsLabel: Some of the houses we make for
home.ctaBody: Tell us the product, the quantities and the market. We'll come back with fabric options, samples and a straight answer on timing.

company.heroLead: Egytaltex was born in 2001 — Egyptian by ground, Italian by mindset. What began as a love for the craft became a vertical house serving an elite clientele.
company.storyP1: We started with a simple conviction: that textiles made with care feel different in the hand and last longer in the wardrobe. From a modest beginning we built, step by step, a small vertical company — keeping yarn, fabric and garment under one roof.
company.storyP2: Operating from the Free Zone in Nasr City, Cairo, we pair Egyptian heritage in cotton with an Italian sense of refinement. We do love what we do, and we do it our way.
company.value1Body: We would rather make less, beautifully, than more, carelessly.
company.value2Body: Owning the full chain means quality answers to us alone.
company.value3Body: We build for clients who notice — and reward — the details.
company.value4Body: The best world cotton, treated with the respect it deserves.
company.t2001: Founded in Cairo with an Italian mentality and a love of craft.
company.t2008: Expanded into a vertical setup — yarn to garment under one roof.
company.t2015: Refined our finishing to serve a growing elite clientele.
company.tToday: A trusted house for brands who value how things are made.

products.heroLead: Eleven categories, one standard. Every programme is developed with the client, sampled, and produced inside our own chain — from dyed yarn to the finished garment.

items.name: Polo shirts
items.desc: Piqué and jersey polos with flat-knit collars, in short and long sleeve.

items.name: T-shirts

items.name: Jackets

items.desc: Crewnecks, hoodies and zip-throughs for everyday wear.

items.desc: Active and leisure pieces cut for movement.

items.desc: Swim shorts and beachwear for resort collections.

items.name: Training suits

items.name: Ladies' dresses & underwear

products.featureBody: Most of what leaves our floor is polos and T-shirts in 100% cotton. A polo shows the whole chain at once: the piqué is knitted on our circular machines, the collar and cuffs on our flat machines, and the finished garment is washed for softness before it is packed.
products.customBody: If it can be knitted from cotton, ask us. Every client programme starts as a conversation.

clients.heroLead: We craft quietly for an elite clientele — brands and houses that value how a thing is made as much as how it looks.
clients.bodyTitle: Trusted by those who notice the details
clients.bodyText: Our clients return not for the lowest price, but for the surest quality. We work as a partner: developing programs, protecting standards, and delivering with the consistency a serious brand requires.
clients.sisterText: Egytaltex is part of a small family of aligned textile ventures, allowing us to keep more of the process close and our standards uncompromised.
clients.testimonialQuote: “They treat our product like their own. The hand-feel, the finishing, the consistency — it is exactly why we keep coming back.”

contact.heroLead: Tell us about your project. We build to order and reply to every serious enquiry.
